scripts.dev: concurrently --names "server,client" --prefix-colors "yellow,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently --names "server,client" --prefix-colors "yellow,cyan" "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run start --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
